strings.seo.faq[0].q: A pdff ke ya mahala tota?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ee. Sedirisi sengwe le sengwe ke sa mahala, go se na letshwao le go se na sepe se se thibetsweng ka fa morago ga ikwadiso. Ga go na karete ya sekoloto e e kopiwang.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Nnyaa. Ga go na kwadiso, ga go na aterese ya imeile: o dirisa didirisi ka nako eo.
strings.seo.faq[2].q: A tokumente tsa me di a bolokwa?
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Nnyaa. Mabete a gago a dirisediwa fela tiro e o e kopileng, mme a a phimolwa. Ga go ope yo o di balang le gape ga di abelwe ope.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ee. pdff e bereka mo sebatling sa mogala o o rileng, letlapa kgotsa khompyutara (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), go se na sepe se se tlhokang go tlhomiwa.

strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, ditshwantsho (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML le tse dingwe.

strings.privacy.title: Sephiri
strings.privacy.description: Ka fa pdff e tshwarang mabete a gago ka teng: ga go na akhaonte, ga go na tokumente e e bolokweng, ga go na papatso le go rekisiwa ga tshedimosetso.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff e dirilwe gore tokumentه tsa gago di nne tsa gago. Mono ke ka mafoko a a motlhofo, se se diragalang fa o e dirisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Mabete a gago
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: A romelwa a sireleditswe (HTTPS), a dirwa ka boyona, mme a phimolwa ka nako fela e tshedimosetso e e tswang e siameng ka yone. Mabete a magolo a feta mo polokelong ya nakwana ka leina le le sa tlhomamang mme a phimolwa fa tiro e fela; phepafatso ya ka boyona e phimola sengwe le sengwe se se ka salang mo diureng di le 24 go ya kwa godimo.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Ga go na akhaonte, ga go na tshedimosetso ya motho
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ga e kake ya kopa kwadiso, aterese ya imeile le karete ya sekoloto. Tokumente tsa gago ga diake tsa balwa, tsa sekasekiwa, tsa abelwa kgotsa tsa dirisediwa go ruta botlhale jwa maano.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Tekanyo ya babogedi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Re bala baeng ka tsela e e sa itsiweng le go se na dikuki (Vercel Web Analytics) go Ithuta gore ke didirisi dife tse di molemo. Ga go na papatso, ga go na tatelo ya mafaratlhatlha.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Dikuki
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki e le nngwe e e ikgethileng: e gopola puo e o e tlhophileng.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Polokelo

strings.legal.terms.description: pdff e gololesegile mo mongwe le mongwe, go akaretsa dikgwebo le puso. Ditokomane tsa gago di nna tsa gago: ga go sepe se se sekasekwang kgotsa se se bolokwang.
strings.legal.terms.intro: Melao e e laola tiriso ya gago ya pdff. E kwadilwe ka boikaelelo jwa go nna khutshwane le ka puo e e bonolo. Ka go dirisa lebala le, o e amogela.
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: Ke mang yo o phasalatsang pdff
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdff e tlhamegile, ya agwa le go phasalatswa ke Mikailou Cedric Toure, mmatli wa mananeo yo o nnang New Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Laesense ya mahala ya tiriso, ya mongwe le mongwe
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdff e mahala, ntle le go kwadisa le ntle le selekanyo sa nako, ya mongwe le mongwe: batho ba le bosi, baithuti, barutiši, dikgwebo, makgotla a a sa direng poelo, baeteledipele ba puso le mebuso, kwa Canada le kwa lefatsheng lengwe le lengwe. Ga go na tiriso e e beletsweng morero o o duelwang, ka gonne ga gona ope. Difaelo tse o di ntshang ke tsa gago ka botlalo: ga di na mokatisi le fa e le kgakololo ya pdff.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Ditokomane tsa gago tsotlhe, le tse di sephiri
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: O ka dira ka mofuta mongwe le mongwe wa tokomane, go akaretsa le tse di sephiri, ka gonne pdff ga e bale, e sekaseke, e boloke kgotsa e abelane difaelo tsa gago: di dirwa ka bo tsona mme morago di phimolwa. O nna mong wa tsona, mme o na le maikarabelo a go nna le ditshwanelo tse di tlhokegang.

strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Khoutu ya motswedi ya pdff e phasaladitswe ka laesense ya MIT. O ka e bala, wa e sekaseka, wa e tsenya mo ditereng tsa gago (go akaretsa le mo lebateng le le tswetsweng le le se nang kgokagano ya Inthanete), wa e fetola le go e aba gape mahala, ka tsela ya gore o bolokakitsiso ya ditshwanelo le sengwalo sa laesense.

Selekanyo sa bogolo le palo ya difaelo se sireletsa tiro bakeng sa mongwe le mongwe.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Botlhokwa jwa go fitlhela
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdff e neelwa e se na tuelo. E ka fetoga, ya kgorelediwa ka ntlha ya tlhokomelo kgotsa ya emisiwa. Dula o tshwere ditokomane tsa gago tsa ntlha: pdff ga e boloke khopi ya tsona.

Go ya koo molao o letlelelang ka teng, mophasalatsi ga a na maikarabelo a tshenyo e e sa tlhamalalang, go latlhegelwa ke data kgotsa phoso ya phetoho. Tlhhatlhoba ditokomane tse o di ntshang pele ga o di dirisetsa sepe se se botlhokwa.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Ditshwanelo tsa tlhaloganyo
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Leina la pdff, letshwao la yone le mafoko a lebala ke tsa mophasalatsi; khoutu e ka tlase ga laesense ya MIT jaaka go tlhalositswe fa godimo. Matshwao a a umakang (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) ke a beng ba ona.
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].title: Molao o o laolang
strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Melao e e laolwa ke melao ya Porofense ya New Brunswick le melao ya federale ya Canada e e diragalang koo. Dikgotlatshekelo tsa New Brunswick di na le thata, go sa ame ditshwanelo tse molao wa lefatsheng la gago o go nayang tsone jaaka moreki.

strings.legal.terms.sections[9].text: Melao e e ka baakanngwa. Letsatsi le le kwa godimo ga tsebe le bontsha mofuta o o diragalang; diphetogo di diragatsa fela tiriso e e diragalang morago ga go phasalatswa ga yone.

strings.legal.security.title: Tshireletso le data
strings.legal.security.description: Go diragalang ka difaelo tsa gago mo pdff: go dira ka botona, go se na thlahlobo, go phimolwa ka bonako, tshireletso ya diphiri, go tsholwa mo Yuropa, le kgetho ya go e tsenya mo ditereng tsa gago.
strings.legal.security.intro: Go diragalang ka difaelo tsa gago, kwa di dirwang teng le ka moo di sireleditsweng ka teng: go tlhalositswe ka bonolo, bakeng sa batho le mafapha a IT.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Ga go na ditokomane tse di bolokweng
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Difaelo tsa gago di dirwa ka botona, mme morago di phimolwa fela fa bokhutlo bo baakanye kgotsa bo jarollwa. Ga gona khopi, ga gona polokelo ya morago le ga gona histori. Go phimola ka botona ka letsatsi go phimola faele epe e e ntseng e le teng, go fitlha ka letsatsi le le latelang mo go fetang.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Ga go na thlahlobo
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Ga go na ope yo o balang ditokomane tsa gago. Ga di balwe, ga di hlahlobwe, ga di abelane kgotsa ga di dirisediwe go ruta botlhale jwa maano. pdff ga e na diakhaonto, ga e na matshwao a papatso le ga e na diphiri tsa badirisi.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Tshireletso ya diphiri
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Kgokagano nngwe le nngwe e sireleditswe (HTTPS) mme lebala le patika tshireletso mo ketong nngwe le nngwe (HSTS). Sedirisi sa Tshireletso se sireletsa di-PDF tsa gago ka AES-256; phasewete e o e tlhophang ga e ise e bolokwe le ka motlha.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Kwa difaelo tsa gago di dirwang teng
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Lebala, di-PDF le disdirisi tsa ditshwantsho: Vercel, lefelo la data la Paris (Fora, Mokgatlo wa Yuropa). Diphetogo tsa Word, Excel le PowerPoint: Render, kwa Frankfurt (Jeremane, Mokgatlo wa Yuropa). Difaelo tse di fetang 4 MB: polokelo ya nako e khutshwane ya Vercel Blob, ka leina le le sa tlhomameng, le phimolilwe morago ga tiriso.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Tshireletso ya botegeniki
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Dihlogo tsa tshireletso (HSTS, go thibela lebala go tsentshwa mo matsebaleng a mangwe, tshireletso kgatlhanong le phoso ya mofuta wa faele), diaterese tsa difaelo tsa nako e khutshwane tse di sa kgonweng go fopholediwa, le tirelo ya phetoho e e amogelang fela dikopo tse di rweleng sesupo se se sephiri. Diphetogo tsotlhe tsa khoutu di hlahlobwa ka botona (tekanyo, tlhhatlhoba ya mefuta) pele ga di tsena mo tirisong.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Bosa sephiri le molao o o diragalang
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff e phasaladitswe mo New Brunswick mme e sala molao wa tshireletso ya tshedimosetso ya motho ka nosi le difaelo tsa eleketeroniki tsa Canada morago (PIPEDA). Ga e kgobokanye tshedimosetso epe ya motho ka nosi ka badirisi ba yone: ga gona akhaonto, ga gona aterese ya imeile, ga gona kuki ya go sala morago. E agile mo melao yotlhe e e tshwanang le ya GDPR ya Yuropa le Molao wa 25 wa Quebec: fokotsa data, go se dirise gape, go phimola morago ga tiriso.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Bakeng sa makgotla a a nang le melao e e gagamalang
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Fa melao ya gago e thibela go romela ditokomane kwa tirelong ya kwa ntle, tsenya pdff mo ditereng tsa gago. Software e e feletseng e mahala, ke ya motswedi o o gololesegileng mme e bereka e se na kgokagano ya Inthanete: ga gona faele epe e e tswang mo lebateng la gago. Tlhahiso ya go tsenya e mo lebateng la porojeke.

strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: O akanya gore o bonye phoso ya tshireletso? E belege ka sephiri go tswa mo lebateng la “Tshireletso” la porojeke:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Botlhofo jwa phihlelo
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Tlhaloso ya botlhofo jwa phihlelo ya pdff: boikaelelo jwa WCAG 2.2 maemo AA, ditsela tse di dirisiwang, melemo e e tsebiphagalang le kafa o ka begang kgoreletso ka teng.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Mongwe le mongwe o tshwanetse go kgona go dirisa pdff, go akaretsa batho ba ba foufetseng kgotsa ba ba bonang ka bonnyane, ba ba sa utlweng sentle, kgotsa ba ba nang le bokowa jwa mmele kgotsa jwa tlhaloganyo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Maemo a boikaelelo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff e ikaelela go dumalana le Melao ya Botlhofo jwa Phihlelo ya Dikgang tsa Marang-rang (WCAG) 2.2, maemo AA, e leng molao wa W3C wa mafatshe a otlhe. Maemo a a akaretsa ditlhoko tsa Molaotheo wa Puso ya Canada wa Botlhofo jwa Phihlelo ya Marang-rang, molao wa Yuropa EN 301 549 le Karolo ya 508 mo United States, tse di suputsang kwa WCAG 2.0 kgotsa 2.1 maemo AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Maemo a tumalano
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff e dumalana ka bontlanyana le WCAG 2.2 maemo AA: melemo e e tsebiphagalang e kwadilwe fa tlase. Tlhaloso e e ikaegile ka tlhhatlhoba ya ka gare e e dirilweng ka Phalane 2, 2026, ka go dirisa sedirisi sa botona (axe, Lighthouse) le tlhhatlhoba ya diatla (keyboard, pharologanyo, godiso, dikitsiso). Ga gona tlhhatlhoba e e ikemetseng e e iseng e dirwe.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Se se leng teng
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Lebala lotlhe le bereka ka keyboard, le kgokagano ya “Tlolela kwa dikungo” le letshwao le le bonalang mo karolong e e diragalang. Pharologanyo ya sengwalo e lekanetse bonyane 4.5:1. Ditiro tsa tiro (go tsentsha, bokhutlo, phoso) di itsisiwe go bala metshine. Molatedi wa difaelo o ka fetolwa ntle le go gapa le go latlhela, ka go dirisa dikonopo. Lebala le sala morao molaetsa wa “fokotsa motsamao” wa sedirisi sa gago: metsamao e emisa ka botlalo. Ditsebe di nna di balega mo godisong ya 400% le mo fonong. Puo ya tsebe nngwe le nngwe e itsisiwe, le puo ya Searabana e bontshiwa go tswa moja go ya lettang.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Melemo e e tsebiphagalang
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Ntle le peakanyo eo, metsamao ya kgabiso (morao, dikologa, letshwao la mefuta) e tswelela ka go sa kgaotse; letshwao le emisa fa o baya godimo le fa o tobetsa keyboard. Letshwao le le tsamayang la tsebe ya gae le diriswa ka mouse kgotsa monwana; ke la kgabiso, mme lenane la mefuta le le le bontshang le teng jaaka sengwalo mo tsebeleng. Dipuo tse di fetotsweng ka motshine di ka nna le diposo. Sa bofelo, botlhofo jwa phihlelo ya tokomane e e ntshitsweng bo ikaegile ka ya ntlha: pdff ga e tsenye dikai tsa botlhofo jwa phihlelo mo PDF e e se nang tsona.

strings.legal.install.description: Tsenya pdff mo ditereng tsa puso ya gago kgotsa dikgwebo: mahala, ke ya motswedi o o gololesegileng, mme ditokomane tsa gago ga di tswe mo lebateng la gago.
strings.legal.install.intro: Mebuso, dikgwebo, dipatela, dikolo: tsenya pdff mo ntlong ka metsotso le go boloka taolo e feletseng ya ditokomane tsa gago.

strings.tools.compresser.name: Menaganya

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Fokotsa PDF go e romela ka imeile kgotsa go e tlhatlhela mo lefelong la maranyaneng la semmuso. Maemo a mararo a menaganyo, mahala.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: A faele ya gago e boima thata bakeng sa imeile kgotsa lebala la marang-rang? E latlhela, boloka "E e kgothaletsweng" mme o tobetse Pinyo. Sengwalo se nna se le bohale.

strings.tools.compresser.options.level.hints.los: Boleng jo bo tshwanang, poelo e nnye.
strings.tools.compresser.options.level.hints.rec: Kgetho e e siameng mo mabakeng mangwe le mangwe.
strings.tools.compresser.options.level.hints.str: E nnye ka moo go kgonegang ka teng; ditshwantsho di nna dimaferetshana.

strings.tools.compresser.guide.uses[1]: Isa tokomane mo lebateng le le nang le selekanyo sa bogolo (gantsi 2 go ya go 5 MB).

strings.tools.compresser.guide.faq[1].a: Go lebega e ne e setse e ntengwe sentle; pdff e go bolelela jalo.

strings.tools.proteger.intro: Pele ga o romela pampiri ya mputle kgotsa tokumente ya bongaka, e khurumetse ka phasakete e e maatla: go sena yone, ga go ope yo o ka e bulang.

strings.tools.proteger.guide.uses[0]: Romela pampiri ya tuelo, faele ya kalafi kgotsa tumalano e baeng ba sa kgoneng go e bula.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.uses[1]: Thibela go gatisa, go kopa kgotsa go fetola tokomane.

strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[1].title: Tlhopha phasewete
strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[1].text: Le, fa e tlhokega, se se sa letlelelweng: go gatisa, go kopa, go fetola.

strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[2].text: PDF e khoutetswe ka AES-256; abana phasewete ka tsela e nngwe.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.faq[0].a: Ee: AES-256, maemo a a dirisiwang ke dibanka le mebuso. Ntle le phasewete, dikota ga di balesege.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.faq[1].q: A pdff e boloka phasewete ya me?
strings.tools.proteger.guide.faq[1].a: Nnyaa, ga e ise e bolokwe le ka motlha. Fa o e lebala, ga gona ope yo o kgonang go bula faele.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Tlosa phasakete mo PDF e o itseng phasakete ya yone, go e bula, go e gatisa kgotsa go e kopanya ka gololesega. Mahala.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: O itse phasakete, mme go e kwala nako nngwe le nngwe ke mathata? E tlose gangwe fela. pdff ga eake ya feta phasakete e o sa e itseng.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Tlogela e se na sepe fa PDF e na fela le phasakete ya tetla.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.uses[1]: Tlosa tshireletso pele ga o kopanya kgotsa o fetola PDF.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.uses[2]: Boloka ditokomane ntle le kotsi ya go latlhegelwa ke phasewete ya tsona.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[1].title: Tsenya phasewete ya yone
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[1].text: Ponelopele e tlhagelela fela fa e ne e siame.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[2].title: Tobetsa Bulolola
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[2].text: O jarolla PDF e se na tshireletso.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.faq[0].a: Nnyaa. pdff e tlosa fela tshireletso ya ditokomane tse phasewete ya tsona e leng ya gago.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.faq[1].q: A melao ya go gatisa le yone e a tlosiwa?
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.faq[1].a: Ee, PDF e e nnang teng ga e na melao epe.

strings.tools.caviarder.seoDescription: Tlosa maina, diaterese, nomoro le mafelo ka boammaaruri mo PDF: dikahare tse di fitlhilweng di phimolwa mo faeleng, ga di khurumediwe fela. Mahala, ga go na kwadiso.

strings.tools.caviarder.options.terms.help: Kgaoganya ka dikoma. Mafoko otlhe a phimolwa, go sa kgathalesege gore a kwadilwe ka ditlhaka tse dikgolo kgotsa tse dinyane.

strings.tools.ocr.name: Bala skano
strings.tools.ocr.tagline: Dira gore thaka ya tokomane e e skantsweng kgotsa e e ntshetsweng setshwantsho e batlisege le go kopaiwa.
strings.tools.ocr.seoTitle: OCR ya inthaneteng ya mahala: dira gore PDF e e skantsweng e batlisege
strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Bala thaka ya PDF e e skantsweng kgotsa setshwantsho (OCR) gore o kgone go e batla, go e kopaea kgotsa go e buisa kwa godimo. Puo di le 16, mahala, tokomane ga e tlhatlhogiwe.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Tokomane e e skantsweng kgotsa e e ntshetsweng setshwantsho ke setshwantsho fela: o ka se batle lefoko kgotsa wa kopaea thaka. Bala skano e lemoga tlhaka nngwe le nngwe (e bidiwa OCR) mme e tsenya thaka ya nnete mo tokomaneng kwantle ga go fetola kafa e lebegang ka teng. Go bala go direga mo sedireng sa gago: tokomane ya gago ga e tlhatlhogiwe. Ke mohlala fela wa puo e e tlhophilweng (MB e le mmalwa) o o jarololwang gangwe fela.

strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[0].a: PDF ga se fomo e e buisanang (gantsi ke skano). O tla tshwanelwa ke go e gatisa kgotsa go kopa mokgatlho mofuta o o buisanang.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[1].a: Dikarabo di nna karolo ya tsebe mme di ka se tlholwe di fetolwa.
strings.tools.comparer.name: Papisa
strings.tools.comparer.tagline: Bona se se fetogileng gare ga diphetogo di le pedi tsa PDF.
strings.tools.comparer.seoTitle: Papisa di-PDF di le pedi inthaneteng: bona pharologanyo
strings.tools.comparer.seoDescription: Papisa diphetogo di le pedi tsa konteraka kgotsa tokomane ya PDF: mafoko a a tsenyitsweng ka botala, mafoko a a tlositsweng ka bokhibidu, le pego e e ka jarololwang. Mahala, ga go sepe se se tlhatlhogiweng.
strings.tools.comparer.intro: Tlhatlhoga phetolelo ya kgale, mme morago e ntšhwa: pharologanyo e tlhagelela ka bonako, lefoko ka lefoko. Goba Papisa go jarolla pego. Sengwe le sengwe se direga mo sebatlising sa gago.
strings.tools.comparer.options.ignoreCase.label: Hlokomologa ditlhaka tse dikgolo le tse dinyane
strings.tools.comparer.guide.keywords: papisa di-pdf di le pedi, pdf diff, papisa diphetogo di le pedi tsa tokomane, papisa dikonteraka, bona diphetogo mo pdf
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[0]: Tlhatlhoba se se fetogileng mo konterakeng kgotsa tumalano ya boroko pele ga o e saena.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[1]: Sekaseka diphetogo tse di dirilweng mo pego kgotsa thothobolo.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[2]: Papisa diphetogo di le pedi tsa molawana kgotsa thaka ya semmuso.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[0].title: Tlhatlhoga phetolelo ya kgale
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[0].text: Mme morago e ntšhwa, ka tatelano eo.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].title: Bala pharologanyo
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].text: Botala bo bontsha se se tsenyitsweng, bokhibidu jo bo thadilweng bo bontsha se se tlositsweng.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].title: Goba Papisa
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].text: O jarolla pego gore o e boloke kgotsa o e gatise.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].q: A di-PDF tsa me di a tlhatlhogiwa?
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].a: Nnyaa: papiso e direga gotlhe mo sebatlising sa gago.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].q: A nka papisa dikwadiso tse di skantsweng?
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].a: Ee, morago ga go di dirisa ka sedirisiwa sa Bala skano, se se ntshang thaka ya tsona.
strings.tools.images.name: Ntsha ditshwantsho
strings.tools.images.tagline: Ntsha ditshwantsho le ditshwantshiso mo PDF.
strings.tools.images.seoTitle: Ntsha ditshwantsho mo PDF inthaneteng mahala
strings.tools.images.seoDescription: Ntsha setshwantsho sengwe le sengwe, tshwantshiso le logo mo PDF jaaka PNG kgotsa JPG, kwantle ga dipoeletso. Mahala, ga go na kwadiso, difaelo di phimolwa ka bonako.
strings.tools.images.intro: Tlhatlhoga PDF: pdff e bona setshwantsho sengwe le sengwe se se mo teng mme e go neela tsone ka bongwe ka bongwe, jaaka PNG kgotsa JPG, mo sephuthelong sa ZIP. Ditshwantsho tse dinyane tsa kgabiso le dipoeletso di tlogelwa kwa ntle.
strings.tools.images.options.format.label: Mofuta wa setshwantsho
strings.tools.images.options.format.hints.png: Boleng jo bo gaisang, bo boloka ponagalo.
strings.tools.images.options.format.hints.jpg: Difaelo tse di motlhofo, di siamile thata mo ditshwantshong.
strings.tools.images.options.small.label: Gape boloka ditshwantsho tse dinyane (di-icon, di-bullet)
strings.tools.images.guide.keywords: ntsha ditshwantsho mo pdf, boloka ditshwantsho go tswa mo pdf, ntsha ditshwantsho mo pdf, motlhopholodi wa ditshwantsho tsa pdf
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[0]: Ntsha ditshwantsho mo khathalogo ya PDF, pego kgotsa brošara.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[1]: Dirisa logo kgotsa tšhato gape mo tlhagisong.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[2]: Boloka ditshwantsho tsa tokomane pele ga o e phimola.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[0].title: Tlhatlhoga PDF ya gago
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].title: Tlhopha PNG kgotsa JPG
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].text: PNG bakeng sa boleng jo bo gaisang, JPG bakeng sa difaelo tse di motlhofo.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].title: Goba Ntsha ditshwantsho
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].text: O bona ditshwantsho tsotlhe mo sephuthelong sa ZIP.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].q: Go farologana jang le go fetolela PDF mo JPG?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].a: Go fetolela go dira gore tsebe nngwe le nngwe e nne setshwantsho. Go ntsha ditshwantsho go ntsha fela ditshwantsho le ditshwantshiso tse di mo teng ga matsebe, ka bogolo jwa tsona jwa nnete.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].q: Ke eng ditshwantsho dingwe di seyo?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].a: Ditshwantsho tse dinyane (di-icon, di-bullet) di tlola katlholo: tshwaya "Gape boloka ditshwantsho tse dinyane". Thaka le ditshwantsho tsa vector ga se ditshwantsho, ka jalo ga di ntshiwe.
strings.tools.redimensionner.name: Fokotsa / kgaola
strings.tools.redimensionner.tagline: Fetola bogolo jwa setshwantsho kgotsa o se kgaole.
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoTitle: Fokotsa le go kgaola ditshwantsho inthaneteng mahala
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: Fokotsa setshwantsho (ka % kgotsa ka di-pixel) kgotsa o se kgaole mo sekgweng, 16:9 kgotsa 4:3, mme o se boloke jaaka JPG, PNG kgotsa WebP. Mahala, ga go na kwadiso.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Tlhatlhoga ditshwantsho tsa gago, tlhopha go di fokotsa kgotsa go di kgaola, tlhatlhoba ponelopele, mme o gobone Fokotsa / kgaola. E siamile mo setshwantshong sa profaele, faele e e bokete kgotsa fomo e e batlang bogolo jo bo rileng.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.mode.label: O batla go dira eng?
Boloka setshwantsho sotlhe, se nne se nyenyane.
Kgaola dintshi go bona sebopego se se siameng.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.scale.label: Bogolo jo bosha
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.width.label: Bophara (di-pixel)
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.ratio.label: Mofuta
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.keywords: fokotsa setshwantsho, fokotsa bogolo jwa setshwantsho, kgaola setshwantsho inthaneteng, fokotsa setshwantsho, dira setshwantsho se nne se nyenyane, setshwantsho sa sekgweng
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[0]: Fokotsa setshwantsho se se bokete thata bakeng sa imeile kgotsa fomo ya inthaneteng.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[1]: Kgaola setshwantsho se nne sekgweng bakeng sa profaele.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[2]: Baakanya ditshwantsho tsa 16:9 bakeng sa tlhagiso kgotsa webosaete.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[1].text: Ponelopele e bontsha lefelo le le bolokilweng le bogolo jo bosha.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[2].text: O jarolla ditshwantsho tse di rulagantsweng.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].q: A setshwantsho se latlhegelwa ke boleng?
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].a: Setshwantsho se se nyenyane se na le di-pixel di le nnye mme se dula se le bogale ka bogolo jwa sone jo bosha.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].a: Mo gare ga setshwantsho: dintshi di kgaolwa ka tekatekano go fitlha mofuta o o tlhophilweng, jaaka ponelopele e bontsha.
